run_evaluation_task: run an LCM evaluation task with a RunConfig and predictor to compute metrics
create_run_config: create a RunConfig dataclass to configure a single LCM evaluation task run
build_run_config_from_dict: build a RunConfig from a dictionary or DictConfig using from_dict class method
update_dataset_params: update dataset parameters in RunConfig based on task registry defaults
compute_confidence_intervals: compute confidence interval bounds for average metrics using compute_ci method
